steps.description:
Results are written by COVA, not by you — this form is normally read rather than filled.

Where you go next: Request takes you back to the Clinic Test Request that asked for it, and Visit to the clinic visit it came out of. Clinical Outcome is the verdict that matters — FitForWork, FitWithRestrictions, UnfitForWork or InconclusiveRetestRequired — and the Risk rows grade each condition behind it.

All of it rolls up into Test Results on the Clinic Analytics dashboard, where each outcome tile opens the list of people behind it.

Fill the fields marked required and press Save (Ctrl+S). The onboarding step ticks itself off as soon as the record exists.
